inherited_cases.name: Desa Green 715-sf two-bedroom control
inherited_cases.source_note: Sale ask 430,000 with 480,000 crossed out; medium-floor 715 sf, 2 beds/2 baths, one bay, fully furnished claim. Rent header 1,699/body 1,700, partly furnished, one bay, available 1 September 2026. Different units and furnishings, not a same-package realised pair. Use rounded rent 1,700 solely as a partial-fit-out diagnostic.
inherited_cases.mechanism: A second real bedroom expands usable space for a couple needing work/child space, but that benefit competes with one-bedroom affordability and with the opportunity to rent.
inherited_cases.buyer: Small households that need a separate room and local access; investor demand must pay for the added quantum from actual net rent. Young owner adoption is a possibility, not a measured buyer share.
inherited_cases.project: UOA identifies 1,388 units over three towers and 578-945 sf. M Aspira is a competing future family-format supply source. Existing management/capex and tower-specific resident experience remain unverified.
inherited_cases.unit: Original plan, exact tower, orientation and bay rights are missing. The 715-sf label occurs in sale and rent, but the furnishing difference prevents treating the rent gap to R203 as pure bedroom value.
inherited_cases.comp: R203 Desa Green 578-sf one-bedroom at 345,000 / assumed 1,600 rent is the first internal control. M Aspira's starting marketing price is a future utility/financing alternative, not a present resale comp. Older family stock is a different space/age trade-off.
inherited_cases.counter: The two-bedroom could rent materially higher after equivalent furnishing; the low partial-furnishing ask may understate attainable rent for the sale package. Conversely, location appeal cannot create the extra income needed merely because 430,000 is affordable to an owner.
inherited_cases.reversal: At unchanged fee, standard coverage needs rent above 2,014; 6% gross needs 2,150. A current same-package achieved rent at or above those levels would improve the income ranking; it would still not validate G0 or net profitability.
inherited_cases.next: Compare original 578/715 plans, one-bay rights and same-furnishing whole-unit leases. Resolve net entry and strata charge bill before a price recommendation.

inherited_cases.name: The Tropika 732-sf two-bedroom control
inherited_cases.source_note: September 2026 sale index identifies 650,000/732 sf/2BR/2BA/two bays; May 2026 rent index includes fully furnished 2,800 and 2,999 asks. Price and rent are separate indexed units. Unmatched 820-sf or 1,025-sf promotional sale rows excluded from type inference.
inherited_cases.mechanism: A true two-bedroom near daily retail/park amenities may serve a couple/small family with more flexible long-term use than a studio; entry absorbs much of the apparent rental advantage.
inherited_cases.buyer: Small owner households and income investors considered separately. Two bays can widen household utility only if legally attached and usable. No assumed owner premium or guaranteed professional-tenant allocation.
inherited_cases.project: Developer explicitly identifies the 732-sf 2BR type and larger 974/1,251/1,318-sf 3BR types. Retail presence does not certify maintenance, walkability or rent. Treat as a residential product contrast to the unresolved R205 component, not proof R205 is comparable.
inherited_cases.unit: Original developer type is clearer than Aurora's alias, but exact parcel, strata use, views, privacy, bays and lender acceptance remain open. Fee 340 and fit-out 25,000 are analyst allowances.
inherited_cases.comp: Within-project larger types distinguish family utility from price-per-foot. Brickz's 15 June 2025-April 2026 records are size-mixed; 710-sf/3-room coding conflicts with marketed 732-sf/2BR and is not normalised automatically.
inherited_cases.counter: Current high rents might reflect a successful niche, but a 650,000 price needs more than 2,800 rent for the common coverage standard. The 600,000/630,000 reported 710-sf transfers could be relevant after reconciliation, or be different rights/size records.
inherited_cases.reversal: At fee 340, rent needs about 2,930 for standard coverage and 3,250 for 6% gross at 650,000. The upper tested 3,000 rent changes the standard sign but not the 6% result; no base growth is assumed.
inherited_cases.next: Resolve 710-versus-732 area basis and recorded room count, match a voluntary transfer and actual two-bay tenancy, then obtain operating evidence.

inherited_cases.name: M Oscar 708-sf two-bedroom control
inherited_cases.hold: Current index-only offer; original parcel/availability not verified
inherited_cases.source_note: Current aggregator displays an owner-listed 528,000/708-sf move-in-ready sale and 2,400 whole-unit fully furnished two-bay rent; independent June rent index has 2,300 and 2,500 asks. Use 2,300 scenario. Historical 479,000 sale dated 29 May 2025 is not a live cheaper offer. Source's generic flood/crime descriptions not adopted.
inherited_cases.mechanism: A completed newer two-bedroom gives a design/condition alternative to the older Endah compact and Kuchai family expressions; genuine utility must justify the additional capital.
inherited_cases.buyer: Small household use and investor income are plausible channels; owner's listing badge is not proof the incoming buyer will occupy. No household-exit share assumed.
inherited_cases.project: Mah Sing's 2024 annual report identifies 910 units and Q2 2024 construction completion. Portal 2023 completion labels are not used to establish lifecycle. An award is not an audited fee/capex record.
inherited_cases.unit: 708-sf two-bedroom and two-bay marketing needs an exact plan and rights match. A 300-sf studio rental may be part of a dual-key unit and is excluded as a separate purchasable control.
inherited_cases.comp: Endah 739-sf studio/1BR and Kuchai 935-sf family case trade age/layout/price differently. Datanah exposes a March 2026 710-sf record at 450,000, but labels its size land-area fallback and omits unit identity. It does not certify the 528,000 price or a loss from launch.
inherited_cases.counter: Better facilities/newer age may win young households, yet the 528,000 entry gives only modest gross return. A much lower executable unimpared price could change the conclusion; one unmatched 450,000 record is not that offer.
inherited_cases.reversal: At fee 280, standard coverage needs rent about 2,384; 6% needs 2,640. The upper 2,500 rent test passes standard coverage but not 6%; use actual costs and no assumed rent uplift.
inherited_cases.next: Trace current sale to its exact parcel and net price; reconcile 708/710 area, confirmed completion and achieved two-bay rent. Do not recycle the old 479,000 offer as current.

inherited_cases.name: Silk Sky 484-sf compact control
inherited_cases.hold: SOHO/serviced-apartment component and residential admission unresolved
inherited_cases.source_note: April 2026 sale index contains 484-sf asks from 240,000 to 299,000 including furnished 250,000. May whole-unit 484-sf furnished rent asks include 1,200, 1,300 and 1,450. Room advertisements excluded. Neither availability nor exact paired parcel is established.
inherited_cases.mechanism: Low quantum can improve coverage for local working singles or couples without borrowing Akasa's larger household use or central-Cheras rent.
inherited_cases.buyer: Investor-led resale is the provisional compact exit; a younger owner route is uncredited until permitted use, credit and actual adoption are evidenced. No automatic rejection solely for an investor-led channel.
inherited_cases.project: Secondary descriptions disagree between all-SOHO and mixed SOHO/serviced apartments. This is a component-use investigation, not a conclusion that all SOHO is unfit for residence. No current audited management evidence.
inherited_cases.unit: 484-sf original unit versus renamed one-bedroom, exact block and permitted residential use must be established. A furnished image does not establish the legal or financeable product.
inherited_cases.comp: Akasa850 410,000/1,800 and same-project 732-sf two-bedroom/1,044-sf family asks show the housing-task trade-off. A 732-sf furnished rent ask of 1,400 cannot be pooled with a 484-sf studio to infer identical tenant depth.
inherited_cases.counter: The apparent compact yield advantage may survive on a real residential whole parcel, but fee, turnover, future buyer yield and legal/financing constraints could erase it. Larger layouts may be more owner-friendly yet weaker income expressions.
inherited_cases.reversal: At fee 200, 1,300 rent gives only about 104 monthly standard surplus. A 1,200 rent leaves almost no surplus; annual full-cost carry remains negative. No claim of durable 6.24% net yield.
inherited_cases.next: Resolve approved component and actual loan terms first, then same-condition whole-unit lease and strata fees. If nonresidential-only use is established, exclude that exact component from this residential programme.
